03 / MY STORY

A path shaped
by doing.

Connect on LinkedIn ↗

My journey wasn’t linear. Each experience brought me closer to the work I enjoy: understanding a business, improving its workflows, and turning an idea into something practical.

  1. 01 / THE FOUNDATION
    2023–2025 · MBA

    Learning business.

    My MBA gave me a foundation in logistics, supply chain and business analytics. I became interested in how technology could help people solve everyday business problems.

  2. 02 / REQUIREMENTS
    Mesprosoft

    Learning how businesses work.

    As a Business Analyst Intern, I worked closely with the CEO to understand requirements, map workflows and test an AI-assisted internal helpdesk. It taught me to start with the process and the people who use it.

  3. 03 / EXECUTION
    Business & accounting operations

    Getting close to the work.

    Working alongside an accountant and his businesses brought me into requirements, systems, coordination and day-to-day problem solving. I learned to work beyond a fixed job description and follow through on what the business needed.

  4. 04 / PERSPECTIVE
    RoadMate · Founder’s Staff

    Finding my direction.

    A brief experience in the founder’s office exposed me to operations, recruitment, partnerships and business development. It helped clarify where I wanted to focus: coordinating people and processes, solving problems, and building useful systems.

  5. 05 / NOW
    Zain Gents Palace · Nileshwar

    And now, I’m building.

    Today, I’m looking after our family retail business and modernizing the systems behind it. Running the business brings me closer to the realities of stock, billing, customers and daily operations—and gives every improvement a practical purpose.

BUILT FROM THE SHOP FLOOR

A real business.
Real consequences.

Explore Zain POS ↑

At Zain Gents Palace, community trust and hands-on experience have always mattered. As I take on more responsibility, I’m translating that understanding into practical digital workflows through Zain POS.

The work starts at the counter: billing and exchanges, stock visibility, and daily cash reconciliation. I use AI-assisted tools to build and refine systems around the people who use them, then test them against the demands of an operating shop.

I’m building for a business I help run. Every improvement has to earn its place in the daily workflow.
